nodes.name: Hai vectơ cùng hướng
nodes.description: Hai vectơ cùng phương và có cùng hướng.

assignments.rationale: Both occurrences describe the same mathematical concept: two vectors that are parallel and have the same direction. The grade difference (10 vs 12) is not a reason to split, as the definition is identical.
